Finding: Plain-bush clearance alone gives 4c/95 = 2.13 mrad against a 1 mrad screen (R7 numbers). 1 mrad needs c <= 0.024 mm on Ø30.
Proposed_action: Stop bushing iterations. Build a preloaded rolling-bearing cassette with line-bored 165.000±0.015 centres and run bench test E6.
Acceptance_criterion: Working load: tilt <= 1 mrad and centre change <= 0.10 mm. At 200 N·m jam: retained and undamaged.

Finding: No R11 whole-machine batch. Leaf plasticity is not a torque limiter. The mayr 110/160 N·m limiters are in the BOM, but their setting versus the 200 N·m jam is not in the pack.
Proposed_action: Add a 200 N·m jam step to E6 with the actual limiter installed. Get Valpes stall-torque data.
Acceptance_criterion: Shaft, gear and guard retained. No permanent set at gear or support. Limiter slips at its specified torque ±10%.

Finding: The window is consumed by thermal drift and metrology: 4,250 N/mm stack stiffness means 0.01 mm resolves 42.5 N.
Proposed_action: Install with force-measured preload (load cell or calibrated washer). Get batch F-h curves for 002700A (E2).
Acceptance_criterion: One same-case hot loaded solution with measured stack curves: >= 1000 N minimum and <= 1800 N maximum.

Finding: The project screen is 200.8 MPa on 3 mm R107. A clamped 6/8 mm doubler under the existing five M8 screws (F602 limiters) gives 55/31 MPa net. Bolt increment <= 0.79 kN.
Proposed_action: Adopt the clamped doubler G842-B (Y -90..-55, X -200..36). No welds on R107. Beams welded or bolted to the doubler; face machined after welding.
Acceptance_criterion: E5: no joint separation; loaded minimum clearance >= 1.0 mm; return <= 0.02 mm.

Finding: The clash is with fixture rib F620_002 (MANUAL only). Shifting it -6 mm clears; -15 mm gives a 10.3 mm gap. Separately, the shoe sits on the host face of P107 (X -335..-329), and the host is not modelled.
Proposed_action: Fixture ECO for F620. Obtain the host interface drawing (D1). Prefer bolted root P-b (P107 top edge) or P-c.
Acceptance_criterion: The host interface must leave the root free. Weld access, or the bolted bracket, is shown on the trial fixture.

Finding: The -9 mm² is a 3x3 mm window-corner cut 22.6-26.9 mm from the M5 axis. The clamp-cone radius is about 8.3 mm. Area loss is 1.5%, outside the clamped zone.
Proposed_action: Record the calculation. No geometry change.

Finding: Beam weak-axis rotation bound is 7-15 mrad at a root Mz of 29.6 N·m. In-plane frame motion at the A709 is small; this needs measurement.
Proposed_action: Measure in E5 with dial indicators at the A709/A710/G841 points under 8 directions.
Acceptance_criterion: Loaded minimum clearance >= 1.0 mm with recovery.

Finding: Every hood load ends at the R107 M8 clamp row and the P107 frame, whatever the joint type.
Proposed_action: In E5, measure the gasket-land and flange gap near the M8 row under load.
Acceptance_criterion: No measurable change of gasket compression beyond the F602 limiter tolerance (±0.03).

Finding: Reproduced model: drift scales about 1/kt. kt 1e5->3e5->1e6 gives 0.0404->0.0129->0.0038 deg. Rolling arm 0.030->0.005 gives 0.0404->0.0165. Sphere radius has no effect or is adverse.
Proposed_action: E3 rig: kt from the ±0.30 N·m step; bridge moment-angle loop; full history x10 cycles. L1 sets the joint allocation (D3).
Acceptance_criterion: kt >= 3e5 N·mm/rad, arm <= 0.015 mm, measured drift within allocation (e.g. <= 0.02 deg thermal, <= 0.015 deg residual).

Finding: Crown p0 is 936-974 MPa against about 1950 MPa first-yield for H900. The B852 press fit causes 459-1070 MPa hoop tension in a 2.51 mm 440C wall.
Proposed_action: Replace the press fit (slip fit + retainer, or ISO 8752). Wire-EDM the bridge with skims and polish the crown. Finish-grind the jaw flat after H900.
Acceptance_criterion: Blue-check contact >= 80% length. No indentation after 10^4 cycles at max Q (E3). Dye-penetrant clean.

Finding: Strip bending 7.46 MPa against H900 yield > 1000 MPa. Average pressure 12.3 MPa.
Proposed_action: Record the calculation. Optionally match the washer bore to the seat.
E2: 10 stacks, load/unload at 20 °C and hot, 24 h hold, 3 pre-cycles. Lot-tag the stacks.
Acceptance_criterion: 350-450 N achievable with U(k=2) <= 5 N, guard band 355-445. Relaxation recorded.

Finding: The 2025 KHK list shows 'None' for the exact suffix.
Proposed_action: Written confirmation of code, bore/hub, certificate and lead time. No substitution without review.
Selected-model CAD, torque/time curves, stops, stall torque and wiring. Freeze A701/A702 after receipt.
Acceptance_criterion: Supplier data package received and checked.

Proposed_action: Revision-specific coupling limits. Use the actual encoder and coupling on the E3 rig.

Finding: Old fixtures rejected; no cradle proof.
Proposed_action: The clamped/bolted hood root makes the hood support itself removable as a unit. A main-rotor cradle still needs its own design and a captured-load test.
Acceptance_criterion: Captured-load proof before any J401 or stud removal.

Finding: Two general-tolerance regimes. No ISO 2553 symbols or WPS. 0.01 mm shim with ±0.015. Unmillable R<=0.1. Relief-corner radius not specified. G830 flatness 0.15 against ISO 13920 E 1.0.
Proposed_action: Issue the §6 standard: ISO 2768-mK, ISO 13920-BF, ISO 2553, WPS per ISO 15614-1, datum frames and CTQ list.
Acceptance_criterion: RFQ-ready package: every CTQ toleranced, every weld symbolised.

Finding: Native delta reproduced exactly: 263/2488; 5 changed, 10 added, 248 unchanged. PN prefix collisions with unrelated parts: G840 vs G840P1..R2, A704 vs A704R8. P107 is in two weldments (F600P and R11_HOOD_P_ROOT).
Proposed_action: Renumber the R11 beams. Decide P107 ownership and weld sequence.
Acceptance_criterion: Unique, unambiguous PNs. One owner per weldment.
